sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: President-elect Donald Trump has promised a radically different approach to foreign policy from the Biden administration, perhaps nowhere more so than in Ukraine, where Trump has
sentences.zh: 当选总统唐纳德·特朗普承诺采取与拜登政府截然不同的外交政策，这一点在乌克兰问题上体现得尤为明显，特朗普曾

sentences.en: pledged to end the war in a day.
sentences.zh: 誓言要在一天内结束战争。

sentences.en: But just weeks before he's set to take office, the war has taken an unexpected turn.
sentences.zh: 但在他即将就职的前几周，战争却出现了意想不到的转折。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Anton Trinovsky on the conflict's dangerous new phase.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事安东·特里诺夫斯基将带我们了解这场冲突危险的新阶段。

sentences.en: It's Monday, November 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月25日，星期一。

sentences.en: So Anton, we've seen this real ratcheting up in the war in Ukraine over the past week.
sentences.zh: 安东，过去一周我们看到乌克兰战争局势确实在加剧。

sentences.en: Help us understand what's going on.
sentences.zh: 请帮我们分析一下发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, we've seen a bunch of new developments that are really quite dangerous, quite escalatory.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们看到了一系列新的进展，这些进展确实非常危险，且具有升级态势。

sentences.en: We have seen missiles flying across the border between Russia and Ukraine in a way we haven't seen before.
sentences.zh: 我们看到导弹飞越了俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的边境，这是以前从未见过的。

sentences.en: We have seen the Biden administration taking steps that they have not been willing to take before.
sentences.zh: 我们看到拜登政府采取了他们此前不愿采取的行动。

sentences.en: And we've seen a new kind of rhetoric from President Putin in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 而且我们看到了莫斯科的普京总统发表了新一轮的言论。

sentences.en: And what this all adds up to is that the war is becoming more dangerous, more volatile.
sentences.zh: 这一切加起来意味着这场战争正变得更加危险、更加动荡。

sentences.en: And specifically what's happening is that we're getting closer to this war in Ukraine turning into a broader war between Russia and the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们正越来越接近这场乌克兰战争演变成俄罗斯与西方之间更广泛战争的边缘。

sentences.en: So Anton, this is very striking because, you know, just a few months ago we were talking about
sentences.zh: 安东，这非常引人注目，因为你知道，就在几个月前我们还在谈论

sentences.en: the Russians digging into positions in eastern Ukraine, and it was this protracted trench warfare.
sentences.zh: 俄军在乌克兰东部加固阵地，陷入了旷日持久的堑壕战。

sentences.en: How did we get from there to here?
sentences.zh: 我们是怎么从那时走到现在的？

sentences.en: The turning point was early AuguSt.
sentences.zh: 转折点是在8月初。

sentences.en: The unthinkable for many Russians is now a reality.
sentences.zh: 对许多俄罗斯人来说，不可想象的事情现在变成了现实。

sentences.en: Their homeland invaded.
sentences.zh: 他们的国土被入侵了。

sentences.en: Ukraine broke that stalemate by invading Russia.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰通过入侵俄罗斯打破了僵局。

sentences.en: It's the first time there's been a foreign incursion of Russia since World War II.
sentences.zh: 这是二战以来俄罗斯首次遭到外国入侵。

sentences.en: Ukrainian troops went into Russia's Kursk region on the border, captured about 400 square miles
sentences.zh: 乌克兰军队进入了边境的俄罗斯库尔斯克地区，占领了约400平方英里

sentences.en: of territory, and delivered this huge embarrassment to Vladimir Putin, who, it turned out, couldn't even protect what was internationally recognized Russian territory.
sentences.zh: 的领土，并让弗拉基米尔·普京陷入了巨大的尴尬，事实证明，他甚至无法保护国际公认的俄罗斯领土。

sentences.en: Ukraine is proving that it truly knows how to restore justice and is providing the exact pressure needed.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰正在证明它确实知道如何恢复正义，并提供了所需的精确压力。

sentences.en: That incursion into Kursk was a big morale boost for Ukraine, but it came at a coSt.
sentences.zh: 对库尔斯克的入侵极大地提振了乌克兰的士气，但代价也是高昂的。

sentences.en: First, Russians are making gains, capturing partially destroyed villages, raising the Russian tricolor flag.
sentences.zh: 首先，俄军正在取得进展，占领部分被摧毁的村庄，并升起俄罗斯三色旗。

sentences.en: In order to do it, Ukraine had to thin out its troops in eastern Ukraine, where Russia was advancing.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，乌克兰不得不削减在俄军推进的乌克兰东部的兵力。

sentences.en: They just don't have the personnel to hold all this territory.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有足够的人员来守住所有这些领土。

sentences.en: And as a result, Russia was actually able to push forward in eastern Ukraine at a much higher clip than before.
sentences.zh: 结果，俄罗斯实际上能够以比以前快得多的速度在乌克兰东部推进。

sentences.en: In other words, for the first time in a long time, the front line was actually moving, and it was moving to Russia's advantage.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，长期以来前线第一次真正发生了移动，而且是朝着有利于俄罗斯的方向移动。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then this fall, Vladimir Putin pulled out his own surprise.
sentences.zh: 然后在这个秋天，弗拉基米尔·普京抛出了他自己的惊喜。

sentences.en: The Pentagon confirmed that there are North Korean troops now in Russia, especially in the region of Kursk, which is bringing in North Korean troops.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼证实，现在有朝鲜军队在俄罗斯，特别是在库尔斯克地区，这引入了朝鲜军队。

sentences.en: Reportedly, there's something like 10,000 troops from North Korea that are fighting or getting ready to fight on the Russian side.
sentences.zh: 据报道，大约有1万名朝鲜士兵正在或准备在俄罗斯一方作战。

sentences.en: And that was a really remarkable moment, right?
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常引人注目的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: Because suddenly it's about more than just Russia and Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 因为突然之间，这不仅仅是俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的事情了。

sentences.en: There's a third country involved.
sentences.zh: 有第三个国家卷入了进来。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And think about North Korea, how important that country is strategically as a nuclear armed
sentences.zh: 想想朝鲜，考虑到它作为拥有核武器的战略地位有多重要

sentences.en: adversary of the United States and what it shows about how close the strategic relationship between Russia and North Korea has become.
sentences.zh: 作为美国的对手，这表明俄罗斯和朝鲜之间的战略关系已经变得多么紧密。

sentences.en: That has sent shockwaves really around the world.
sentences.zh: 这确实在全世界引起了震动。

sentences.en: Okay, so you've laid out this pretty major shift in the war.
sentences.zh: 好的，你已经阐述了这场战争中这个非常重大的转变。

sentences.en: But of course, all of this was happening in the months leading up to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但当然，这一切都发生在通往美国大选的几个月里，

sentences.en: election, won, of course, by Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 当然，大选是由唐纳德·特朗普获胜的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump's victory in the election is going to have enormous repercussions for the war.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在大选中的胜利将对战争产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Remember his campaign.
sentences.zh: 回想一下他的竞选活动。

sentences.en: He refused to say that he wanted Ukraine to win the war.
sentences.zh: 他拒绝说他希望乌克兰赢得战争。

sentences.en: He promised to end the war in 24 hours, which was widely seen as him being open to a deal that could essentially sell Ukraine out to Russia.
sentences.zh: 他承诺在24小时内结束战争，这被广泛视为他愿意达成一项本质上可能将乌克兰出卖给俄罗斯的协议。

sentences.en: He brought on J.D.
sentences.zh: 他选择了J.D.

sentences.en: Vance as his vice president, who has been extremely critical of American support for Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 万斯作为他的副总统，万斯一直对美国支持乌克兰持极其批评的态度。

sentences.en: So you've had so many signals coming from the Trump camp that his presidency will be much tougher for Ukraine than the Biden presidency was.
sentences.zh: 所以你从特朗普阵营听到了很多信号，表明他的总统任期对乌克兰来说将比拜登政府时期更加艰难。

sentences.en: So Trump's election, in other words, was very bad news for the Ukrainians because the Americans and Biden in particular was their biggest ally and he's gone.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，特朗普的当选对乌克兰人来说是个坏消息，因为美国人，特别是拜登，是他们最大的盟友，而他要走了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So when Donald Trump won, President Zelenskyy in Ukraine swung in to win over Donald Trump mode.
sentences.zh: 所以当唐纳德·特朗普获胜时，乌克兰的泽连斯基总统立刻切换到了争取唐纳德·特朗普支持的模式。

sentences.en: And, you know, he was one of the first world leaders to have a phone call with him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是最早与特朗普通话的外国领导人之一。

sentences.en: He tweeted congratulating Trump on impressive election victory.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上祝贺特朗普取得了令人印象深刻的选举胜利。

sentences.en: And so there's a hope in Ukraine that Trump will still want to support their fight, that supporting Ukraine will be kind of a way that Trump projects American strength globally.
sentences.zh: 因此，乌克兰方面希望特朗普仍然愿意支持他们的战斗，支持乌克兰可以成为特朗普在全球范围内展示美国实力的一种方式。

sentences.en: But still, I think there's a huge amount of concern among supporters of Ukraine everywhere that Trump will just see it as much less of a national interest for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，乌克兰的支持者们仍然非常担心，特朗普会认为允许乌克兰继续战斗并以某种方式在战争中击败俄罗斯，

sentences.en: to allow Ukraine to keep fighting and somehow defeat Russia in this war.
sentences.zh: 对美国来说国家利益要小得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which by definition is good for Russia.
sentences.zh: 而这在定义上对俄罗斯是有利的。

sentences.en: So tell us how Putin and Russia are thinking about this Trump win.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我们普京和俄罗斯是如何看待特朗普这次获胜的。

sentences.en: So to step back for a sec, Putin's fundamental bet throughout this war has been that at the
sentences.zh: 退一步说，普京在整场战争中的基本赌注一直是，归根结底，

sentences.en: end of the day, Russia cares more about Ukraine and is willing to sacrifice more to win in Ukraine than does the West, than do the United States.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯比西方、比美国更关心乌克兰，也更愿意为了在乌克兰获胜而做出牺牲。

sentences.en: And so to Putin, Trump's victory shows that at the end of the day, many Americans don't care enough
sentences.zh: 所以对普京来说，特朗普的胜利表明，归根结底，许多美国人并不关心

sentences.en: about Ukraine to continue sending tens of billions of dollars of weapons there and to be in a situation where Russia is threatening an escalation that could draw the U.S.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰，以至于不愿继续向那里输送数百亿美元的武器，也不愿处于俄罗斯威胁升级可能将美国

sentences.en: into a direct war with the world's other nuclear superpower.
sentences.zh: 拖入与世界上另一个核超级大国的直接战争的境地。

sentences.en: At the same time, it also brings Putin closer to something he could call victory in Ukraine, because Putin's primary goal at this point is not to capture more territory.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这也让普京更接近他可以称之为在乌克兰获胜的目标，因为普京目前的主要目标不是占领更多领土。

sentences.en: His main goal is some kind of deal that would allow him to end the war and say he won it.
sentences.zh: 他的主要目标是达成某种协议，让他能够结束战争并宣称自己赢了。

sentences.en: Okay, so basically with Trump's victory, it really seemed like things were on a glide path to exactly the kind of outcome that Putin wanted.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以基本上随着特朗普的胜利，事情似乎确实走上了通往普京所期望结果的轨道。

sentences.en: Not quite, because for one thing, Donald Trump is not in power yet.
sentences.zh: 不完全是，因为首先，唐纳德·特朗普还没有掌权。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration has been very clear on seeking to continue to support Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 而且拜登政府在寻求继续支持乌克兰方面一直非常明确。

sentences.en: That became even more clear in the last couple of weeks when President Biden made a really important shift in his own policy.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，这一点变得更加清晰，当时拜登总统在自己的政策上做出了一个非常重要的转变。

sentences.en: For the first time, he allowed Ukraine to use American missiles to strike deep inside Russian territory.
sentences.zh: 他首次允许乌克兰使用美国导弹深入打击俄罗斯境内。

sentences.en: These missiles are called the TakuMs.
sentences.zh: 这些导弹被称为陆军战术导弹系统（ATACMS）。

sentences.en: They have a range of 190 miles.
sentences.zh: 它们的射程为190英里。

sentences.en: Ukraine has been asking for months, if not longer, to be able to use these missiles for those kinds of
sentences.zh: 乌克兰几个月甚至更久以来一直要求能够使用这些导弹进行此类

sentences.en: strikes inside Russia in order to disrupt Russia's ability to build up its forces, resupply its forces, and wage this war.
sentences.zh: 对俄罗斯境内的打击，以破坏俄罗斯集结部队、补给部队和发动这场战争的能力。

sentences.en: The Biden administration has resisted that because they feared that that would be the kind of thing that could really push Putin to escalate the war in a new way.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府此前一直抵制这一点，因为他们担心这可能会真正促使普京以新的方式升级战争。

sentences.en: But then Putin brought in those North Korean troops that we talked about.
sentences.zh: 但随后普京引入了我们刚才提到的那些朝鲜军队。

sentences.en: And that apparently, as our colleagues in Washington have reported, is what pushed President Biden to change
sentences.zh: 据我们在华盛顿的同事报道，这显然是促使拜登总统改变

sentences.en: course and allow Ukraine to use those American missiles for strikes inside Russia.
sentences.zh: 方针并允许乌克兰使用这些美国导弹对俄罗斯境内进行打击的原因。

sentences.en: And how soon does Ukraine make use of these long-range rockets?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰多久会使用这些远程火箭？

sentences.en: Just about immediately.
sentences.zh: 几乎是立刻。

sentences.en: Tonight's anxious hours after Ukraine fired American-made long-range missiles called AtakuMs.
sentences.zh: 今晚，在乌克兰发射了名为ATACMS的美国制造远程导弹后的焦虑时刻。

sentences.en: Last Tuesday, they fired these Atakum missiles and hit an ammunition depot in the Bransk region of southwestern Russia.
sentences.zh: 上周二，他们发射了这些ATACMS导弹，击中了俄罗斯西南部布良斯克地区的一个弹药库。

sentences.en: And then on Wednesday, Ukraine fired Storm Shadow cruise missiles, which are these British-manufactured long-range missiles into the Kursk region.
sentences.zh: 然后周三，乌克兰向库尔斯克地区发射了“风暴阴影”巡航导弹，这是英国制造的远程导弹。

sentences.en: Neither of those, as far as we know, did massive damage.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这两次打击都没有造成大规模破坏。

sentences.en: But the symbolism was enormous.
sentences.zh: 但象征意义是巨大的。

sentences.en: For the first time, Ukraine was firing Western-provided missiles deep into Russian territory, leaving everyone asking, what does Putin do now?
sentences.zh: 这是乌克兰首次向俄罗斯境内深处发射西方提供的导弹，让所有人都问：普京现在会做什么？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘文娜。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏之一《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏是由人制作的，就像你们刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往nytimes.com/games开始今天的游戏吧。

sentences.en: So you've set up this very high-stakes moment for Putin.
sentences.zh: 所以你为普京设定了一个赌注非常高的时刻。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has crossed his red line, allowing the use of these missiles into Russia.
sentences.zh: 已经越过了他的红线，允许在俄罗斯境内使用这些导弹。

sentences.en: They're kind of throwing down the glove, if you will.
sentences.zh: 他们可以说是在下战书。

sentences.en: What does Putin do?
sentences.zh: 普京会怎么做？

sentences.en: The first thing we see is early in the week, less than two days after the news comes out
sentences.zh: 我们看到的第一件事是在本周初，在新闻传出不到两天后，

sentences.en: that President Biden is going to allow Ukraine to strike Russian territory with those American-made missiles, Putin approves Russia's revised nuclear doctrine.
sentences.zh: 即拜登总统将允许乌克兰用那些美国制造的导弹打击俄罗斯领土，普京批准了俄罗斯修订后的核学说。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那意味着什么？

sentences.en: So it sounds bureaucratic, but it's actually pretty serious.
sentences.zh: 听起来很官僚，但实际上相当严重。

sentences.en: The nuclear doctrine defines how and when Russia would consider using its nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 核学说定义了俄罗斯将如何以及何时考虑使用其核武器。

sentences.en: And remember, Russia has a massive stockpile of nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 记住，俄罗斯拥有庞大的核武器储备。

sentences.en: So Putin revises this doctrine to lower the threshold at which Russia would consider using nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 所以普京修订了这一学说，降低了俄罗斯考虑使用核武器的门槛。

sentences.en: And not just that, he also updates it to say that an attack from a non-nuclear state, if backed by a nuclear power, will be treated as a joint attack on Russia.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还更新了学说，称如果无核国家在核大国的支持下对俄罗斯发动攻击，将被视为对俄罗斯的联合攻击。

sentences.en: A looser trigger, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 可以说是一个更宽松的触发器。

sentences.en: And specifically, it relates to Ukraine because Ukraine, not a nuclear power, but the United
sentences.zh: 具体来说，这与乌克兰有关，因为乌克兰不是核大国，但美国

sentences.en: States is a nuclear power.
sentences.zh: 是一个核大国。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Putin has this enormous nuclear arsenal, but he hasn't been able to figure out how to use it effectively as a deterrent against the U.S.
sentences.zh: 普京拥有庞大的核武库，但他一直没能弄清楚如何有效地将其作为对美国的威慑力量。

sentences.en: And so that's what this new doctrine is about, finding a new way, basically, to scare Americans.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是新学说的意义所在，基本上是找到一种恐吓美国人的新方法。

sentences.en: And it seems that it did, in a way.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来确实起到了一定作用。

sentences.en: Last Wednesday, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 上周三，美国

sentences.en: embassy in Kiev issued this urgent warning saying that Russia might launch a significant air attack and closed its embassy and told employees to shelter in place,
sentences.zh: 驻基辅大使馆发布了紧急警告，称俄罗斯可能会发动大规模空袭，并关闭了大使馆，要求员工就地避难，

sentences.en: which was a really rare move.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常罕见的举动。

sentences.en: Obviously, Kiev has been attacked many, many times during the course of the last almost three years.
sentences.zh: 显然，在过去近三年的时间里，基辅遭受了多次袭击。

sentences.en: And for much of that time, the embassy has been operating.
sentences.zh: 而在那段时间的大部分时间里，大使馆一直在运作。

sentences.en: So closing the embassy was another signal that things were getting even more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 所以关闭大使馆是局势变得更加危险的另一个信号。

sentences.en: So what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么？

sentences.en: Was there an attack?
sentences.zh: 有袭击吗？

sentences.en: So on Thursday, there was.
sentences.zh: 周四确实发生了。

sentences.en: Russia raised the stakes in the war against Ukraine by firing an experimental ballistic missile.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯通过发射一枚实验性弹道导弹，提高了对乌克兰战争的赌注。

sentences.en: And it's the first of its kind to be used in this conflict.
sentences.zh: 这是此类导弹首次在这场冲突中使用。

sentences.en: Russia does something it hasn't done since the start of the war, which is to use a new missile, something similar to the kind that's used to deliver strategic nuclear weapons.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯做了一件自战争开始以来从未做过的事情，那就是使用了一种新型导弹，类似于用于运载战略核武器的那种导弹。

sentences.en: It has a range of 3,000 miles.
sentences.zh: 它的射程为3000英里。

sentences.en: That means it's a weapon that could be capable of reaching targets across Europe.
sentences.zh: 这意味着它是一种能够打击欧洲各地目标的武器。

sentences.en: We're talking about something that would be used for a large-scale nuclear attack.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是一种可用于大规模核打击的武器。

sentences.en: And it uses this missile to strike in a Ukrainian city, Dnipro.
sentences.zh: 它利用这种导弹袭击了乌克兰城市第聂伯罗。

sentences.en: This is a kind of missile that releases multiple warheads.
sentences.zh: 这是一种能释放多个弹头的导弹。

sentences.en: So you see in videos of this attack, these multiple glowing orbs kind of dropping one after the other.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这次袭击的视频中可以看到，这些发光的球体一个接一个地落下。

sentences.en: It's the kind of missile developed to do really massive damage.
sentences.zh: 这是一种旨在造成巨大破坏的导弹。

sentences.en: To be clear, this particular missile didn't have nuclear warheads in it.
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，这种特定的导弹并没有携带核弹头。

sentences.en: But think about the message that that's sending.
sentences.zh: 但想想这传递出的信号。

sentences.en: And on top of all that, these warheads are designed to attack at hypersonic speeds, meaning multiple times the speed of sound.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这些弹头旨在以高超音速进行攻击，也就是数倍于音速的速度。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So air defenses don't work against them.
sentences.zh: 所以防空系统对它们不起作用。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so it was all about sending this signal that Russia was ready to respond and ready to escalate further.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是为了发出一个信号，即俄罗斯已准备好反击，并准备进一步升级局势。

sentences.en: So Putin keeps trying to get the West to listen, to pay attention.
sentences.zh: 普京一直在试图让西方倾听，让西方关注。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And he doesn't just launch that missile.
sentences.zh: 而且他不仅仅是发射了那枚导弹。

sentences.en: He then gives a speech, a televised speech to the nation of the kind he delivers very rarely.
sentences.zh: 随后他还发表了讲话，一种他极少进行的全国电视讲话。

sentences.en: He's sitting in what looks like the same wood-paneled office as where he was when he launched the invasion in February 2022.
sentences.zh: 他坐在看起来和2022年2月发动入侵时相同的木镶板办公室里。

sentences.en: He looked pretty tired, pretty weary, aggrieved.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很疲惫，很厌倦，满腹委屈。

sentences.en: And he says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: We consider ourselves entitled to use our weapons against the military facilities of those countries that allowed their weapons to be used against our facilities.
sentences.zh: 我们认为我们有权对那些允许其武器被用于攻击我们设施的国家的军事设施使用我们的武器。

sentences.en: In other words, a direct reference to what happened with Biden allowing the use of the ATAKAMs.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这是对拜登允许使用陆军战术导弹系统（ATACMS）一事的直接回应。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Last week.
sentences.zh: 就在上周。

sentences.en: And so it sounds like what he's saying here is that he would be willing to attack the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来他在这里表达的意思是，他愿意攻击美国。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, it's the kind of threat he's made throughout this war kind of vaguely.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是他在整场战争中一直以某种模糊方式发出的威胁。

sentences.en: But this is the most explicit we've heard him say this.
sentences.zh: 但这却是我们听到的最明确的一次表态。

sentences.en: And toward the end of the speech, he lays that out and then comes back with yet another threat.
sentences.zh: 在演讲快结束时，他阐述了这一点，随后又抛出了另一个威胁。

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: I would like to emphasize once again that it was not Russia, but the United States that destroyed the international security system.
sentences.zh: 我想再次强调，摧毁国际安全体系的不是俄罗斯，而是美国。

sentences.en: And by continuing to fight and cling to its hegemony, they are pushing the whole world into a global conflict.
sentences.zh: 通过继续战斗并紧抓霸权不放，他们正在将全世界推向一场全球冲突。

sentences.en: We have always preferred and are ready now to resolve all disputes by peaceful means, but we are also ready for any turn of events.
sentences.zh: 我们一直倾向于，并且现在也准备好通过和平手段解决所有争端，但我们也为任何事态发展做好了准备。

sentences.en: If anyone still doubts this, make no mistake, there will always be a response.
sentences.zh: 如果还有人对此存疑，请不要误解，反击永远会到来。

sentences.en: So this is pretty remarkable and seems pretty frightening.
sentences.zh: 这非常引人注目，而且看起来相当可怕。

sentences.en: What did you make of it, Anton?
sentences.zh: 安东，你怎么看？

sentences.en: I mean, you've been following Putin for a long time.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，你关注普京已经很长时间了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, Putin has been making threats toward the West, including with references, veiled references to his nuclear arsenal since day one of the invasion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，自入侵第一天起，普京就一直在威胁西方，包括含蓄地提及他的核武库。

sentences.en: But what makes this situation, I think, particularly concerning is the specificity of it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，让这种情况特别令人担忧的是它的具体性。

sentences.en: You know, Putin's previous threats have been quite vague.
sentences.zh: 你知道，普京之前的威胁一直相当模糊。

sentences.en: And so that's the concerning thing here.
sentences.zh: 所以这才是令人担忧的地方。

sentences.en: So what does all of this mean for the possibility of an end to the war, of a settlement like we've been talking about?
sentences.zh: 那么，这一切对于战争结束的可能性，或者我们一直在谈论的某种解决方案意味着什么？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: it's definitely a strange moment because people have been talking more seriously about the potential for a settlement and how that would look than really at any point since the early months of the war.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个奇怪的时刻，因为人们比战争初期以来的任何时候都更认真地讨论达成解决方案的可能性及其形式。

sentences.en: And so as that's happening, you know, you have Putin going essentially all in on this escalatory threat that if he continues to make good on it,
sentences.zh: 正因如此，普京基本上是在孤注一掷地进行这种升级威胁，如果他继续兑现这些威胁，

sentences.en: would clearly make it harder for Donald Trump to actually engage in some kind of negotiations with Putin.
sentences.zh: 显然会使唐纳德·特朗普更难与普京进行某种谈判。

sentences.en: And, you know, think about, obviously, God forbid, if there were to be a direct Russian attack on any kind of American facility,
sentences.zh: 而且，试想一下，当然，上帝保佑，如果俄罗斯真的对任何类型的美国设施发动直接攻击，

sentences.en: how could Donald Trump at that point do something that would make it look like he is doing Putin's bidding in Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 到那时，唐纳德·特朗普怎么可能做出看起来像是他在乌克兰听命于普京的事情呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I guess big picture here, Putin does want the war to be over and he seems to be in a pretty good position to achieve that.
sentences.zh: 但我认为从大局来看，普京确实希望战争结束，而且他似乎处于实现这一目标的有利位置。

sentences.en: Yes, he does.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: But there's still a few weeks to go before Trump comes in and starts trying to end this.
sentences.zh: 但在特朗普上台并开始试图结束这场战争之前，还有几周的时间。

sentences.en: And so in the meantime, there's this pretty frantic, incredibly bloody effort by both sides, by both Russia and Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 因此，在此期间，双方，即俄罗斯和乌克兰，都在进行一场相当疯狂、极其血腥的努力，

sentences.en: to try to grab as much territory or hold on to as much territory as possible before potential negotiations begin.
sentences.zh: 试图在潜在谈判开始前尽可能多地夺取或守住领土。

sentences.en: So what you're seeing for one thing is Putin pushing really hard to get the Ukrainian military out of Kursk.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的一点是，普京正在极力推动将乌克兰军队赶出库尔斯克。

sentences.en: And that, of course, is also where Ukraine is using those new American and British missiles to try to slow the Russian counteroffensive there.
sentences.zh: 当然，这也是乌克兰正在使用那些新的美英导弹试图减缓俄罗斯在那里反攻的地方。

sentences.en: And then you've also got Russia really pushing hard in the Donbass region of eastern Ukraine, trying to grab as much territory as they can,
sentences.zh: 此外，俄罗斯也在乌克兰东部的顿巴斯地区全力推进，试图夺取尽可能多的领土，

sentences.en: despite those casualty rates of a thousand people a day or more that Russia is losing.
sentences.zh: 尽管俄罗斯每天损失的人员伤亡率高达一千人甚至更多。

sentences.en: So there's definitely a lot of jockeying happening ahead of the expectation that when Trump comes to power, he'll at least try to create the conditions for some kind of settlement.
sentences.zh: 因此，在特朗普上台后至少会尝试为某种解决方案创造条件的预期下，双方显然在进行激烈的博弈。

sentences.en: OK, so fundamentally, we are now likely looking at the beginning of the end of this war with Putin as the winner.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么从根本上说，我们现在很可能正目睹这场战争的终局，而普京是赢家。

sentences.en: Well, he's still got to get a deal, and ultimately, he'll still need to sit down at some sort of negotiating table to get that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他仍然需要达成协议，最终他仍然需要坐在某种谈判桌前才能实现这一点。

sentences.en: He's been pretty explicit about what he wants.
sentences.zh: 他对自己想要什么表达得相当明确。

sentences.en: He's made clear that he will not give up territory, the territory that Russia has captured, that's for sure.
sentences.zh: 他已经明确表示，他不会放弃领土，即俄罗斯已经占领的领土，这一点是肯定的。

sentences.en: But what Putin clearly cares more about than territory is the political aspect and the geopolitical aspect of some kind of agreement.
sentences.zh: 但普京显然比领土更关心的是某种协议的政治层面和地缘政治层面。

sentences.en: So most important is that Ukraine will never join NATO.
sentences.zh: 所以最重要的是乌克兰永远不会加入北约。

sentences.en: And then on the other end, of course, Ukraine clearly is going to have a say in this as well.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，当然，乌克兰显然也会对此有发言权。

sentences.en: Well, for Ukraine, what's become clear is that for them also, territory is not the most important thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于乌克兰来说，显而易见的是，对他们而言，领土也不是最重要的。

sentences.en: You know, it does look like there's more and more acceptance that in order to bring this war to a close,
sentences.zh: 你知道，看起来人们越来越接受这样一个事实：为了结束这场战争，

sentences.en: Ukraine will have to accept Russian occupation of part of its lands.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰将不得不接受俄罗斯对其部分领土的占领。

sentences.en: So what Ukraine cares about the most is what are referred to as security guarantees.
sentences.zh: 所以乌克兰最关心的是所谓的安全保障。

sentences.en: How will Ukraine feel assured that Russia won't just reconstitute its forces and attack again a few years from now?
sentences.zh: 乌克兰如何才能确信俄罗斯几年后不会重组军队再次发动攻击？

sentences.en: So then the question is going to become how can Ukraine get security guarantees without being part of the NATO alliance?
sentences.zh: 那么问题就变成了，乌克兰如何在不加入北约联盟的情况下获得安全保障？

sentences.en: Will countries actually sign up for some kind of agreement in which they'll be treaty bound to come to Ukraine's defense if Russia attacks again?
sentences.zh: 各国是否真的会签署某种协议，承诺如果俄罗斯再次发动攻击，他们有条约义务来保卫乌克兰？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If there's anything we've learned over the past few weeks, it's just how tenuous that Western support can be.
sentences.zh: 如果说过去几周我们学到了什么，那就是西方的支持是多么脆弱。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: You know, Russia and Ukraine actually did sit down at the negotiating table together in the first few weeks of the war.
sentences.zh: 你知道，俄罗斯和乌克兰在战争最初的几周确实坐到了谈判桌前。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons we've reported that that negotiation fell apart back in the spring of 2022 is that they couldn't actually figure out a mechanism for those security guarantees for Ukraine that would work.
sentences.zh: 我们报道过，那次谈判在2022年春天破裂的原因之一是，他们实际上无法为乌克兰找到一种行之有效的安全保障机制。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: How do you make Ukraine feel reasonably safe from a new Russian attack?
sentences.zh: 你如何让乌克兰感到相对安全，免受俄罗斯的新一轮攻击？

sentences.en: That was never solved back then, and it's clearly going to be the biggest challenge now.
sentences.zh: 当时这个问题从未得到解决，显然这将是现在最大的挑战。

sentences.en: And that's a really hard problem to solve.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常难以解决的问题。

sentences.en: The West is tired, and it clearly does not seem very inclined to come to the aid of Ukraine, this country that is the obsession of this very tenacious and very dangerous leader,
sentences.zh: 西方已经疲惫不堪，显然不太倾向于援助乌克兰，这个被这位极其顽强且极其危险的领导人所执念的国家，

sentences.en: Putin.
sentences.zh: 也就是普京。

sentences.en: So at the end of the day, Anton, is Putin getting away with it?
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，安东，普京是在逍遥法外吗？

sentences.en: Well, let's remember, first of all, that both the West and Putin have been surprised repeatedly during this war by Ukraine's tenacity and Ukraine's will to fight.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先要记住，在这场战争中，西方和普京多次对乌克兰的顽强和战斗意志感到惊讶。

sentences.en: But we have not seen much sign at this point, even though Ukrainian soldiers are clearly very tired and Ukraine is struggling to get enough men on the battlefield.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，我们还没有看到太多迹象，尽管乌克兰士兵显然非常疲惫，乌克兰也在努力争取足够的兵力投入战场。

sentences.en: But still, we're not seeing that Ukraine is actually ready to stop fighting.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，我们也没有看到乌克兰真的准备停止战斗。

sentences.en: You know, and that means you could even imagine a scenario where even if Trump tries to force some kind of peace deal, Ukraine might try to continue to fight.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这意味着你甚至可以想象这样一种情况：即使特朗普试图强行达成某种和平协议，乌克兰也可能会继续战斗。

sentences.en: But big picture, Sabrina, you raise an important point.
sentences.zh: 但从大局来看，萨布丽娜，你提出了一个重要观点。

sentences.en: Putin has been waging the biggest war of aggression that Europe has seen since World War II.
sentences.zh: 普京一直在发动自二战以来欧洲所见过的最大规模的侵略战争。

sentences.en: It's a war that has cost hundreds of thousands of lives in terms of killed and injured soldiers, and not to mention the civilians that have died in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这场战争导致了数十万士兵伤亡，更不用说在乌克兰死亡的平民了。

sentences.en: But despite all the Western sanctions and the tremendous amounts of weaponry that Ukraine has received from the West, Putin is still going.
sentences.zh: 但尽管有西方的制裁和乌克兰从西方获得的巨额武器援助，普京依然在继续。

sentences.en: Domestically, he's as powerful as he's ever been.
sentences.zh: 在国内，他依然拥有前所未有的权力。

sentences.en: And globally, you know, he may be a pariah in the West, but outside the West, Russia continues to have a lot of influence.
sentences.zh: 在全球范围内，你知道，他可能在西方是个贱民，但在西方之外，俄罗斯继续拥有很大的影响力。

sentences.en: So, as we approach the three-year mark of this war, it is time, I think, for serious questions about what the West has and hasn't been able to accomplish in supporting Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着我们接近这场战争的三周年纪念日，我认为是时候认真审视西方在支持乌克兰方面能够和不能够实现什么了。

sentences.en: The West has been able to keep Ukraine in the fight, but it has not been able to stop Putin.
sentences.zh: 西方能够让乌克兰坚持战斗，但却无法阻止普京。

sentences.en: Anton, thank you.
sentences.zh: 安东，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: President-elect Donald Trump has picked Scott Besant to serve as Treasury Secretary.
sentences.zh: 当选总统唐纳德·特朗普已选择斯科特·贝森特担任财政部长。

sentences.en: Besant is a billionaire hedge fund manager who once supported Democrats, but now endorses the Republican agenda of cutting taxes, rolling back federal regulations,
sentences.zh: 贝森特是一位亿万富翁对冲基金经理，他曾支持民主党，但现在支持共和党减税、撤销联邦监管的议程，

sentences.en: and enacting the sweeping tariffs that Trump has promised.
sentences.zh: 并实施特朗普承诺的全面关税。

sentences.en: He'll also oversee trade talks with China.
sentences.zh: 他还将负责监督与中国的贸易谈判。

sentences.en: The selection came after weeks of debate by Trump and his advisers about who should win the most prominent economic job in his administration.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，特朗普及其顾问就谁应该获得他政府中最显眼的经济职位进行了数周的辩论。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko, Asla Chaturvedi, Michael Simon-Johnson, and Will Reed.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·齐普科、阿斯拉·查图尔维迪、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊和威尔·里德制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Maria Byrne and Patricia Willings, with help from Michael Benoit, contains original music by Marianne Lozano, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 由玛丽亚·伯恩和帕特里夏·威林斯编辑，迈克尔·贝努瓦提供协助，包含玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在此过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: Let's take a moment.
sentences.zh: 让我们花点时间。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
